name: kb_harvest
description: Scan a session transcript for learnings and capture them into the KB. Returns {entries_captured, entries_updated, entries_skipped}. Extracted entries are UNVERIFIED and author=harvest, source=harvest. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder; any other session uses the first MCP client root (roots/list) inside a git repository with an origin remote, as that repository's top level, or the fleet server's working folder when the client offers no roots; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
